messages:
alex (sec): Kicking off the simulated failover drill at 9:30 PT. Scenario: KMS endpoint in primary region becomes unreachable and egress to upstream key replicas is blocked. Goal: validate RBAC emergency flow, audit logs, and network policy fallback. Can everyone confirm availability?

jessica (oncall): I'll be available. Do we have a list of test tenants?

rui (infra): I can flip the netpols in staging to simulate egress block. Will also throttle the KMS SG to 0.

katie (platform): Heads up: platform has automatic fallback to replica key path, but it assumes route to replica is allowed. We'll need to force route fail to test.

sam (eng-sre): Suggest we enable short-lived service account tokens for the affected services beforehand. Rolling a quick RBAC exception is risky, but needed to test failover.

maria (seceng): Agreed. Plan: 1) create a temp role 'emergency-decrypt' with CloudKey:Decrypt only, 2) issue tokens via KMS-issuing flow with 15m TTL, 3) audit-logger in verbose. I'll own the RBAC change.

audit-bot: [automated] audit-stream: starting verbose capture for ids: svc-a, svc-b, svc-c. dest: s3://redwood-test/audit/1765129876

rui (infra): netpol snippet I will apply in staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-to-kms
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 443
```

katie (platform): Note: after sim we must run `kms-reconcile --check-keys` to ensure no lingering key aliases. Also record the latency spike in console.

sam (eng-sre): During the sim, if services can't decrypt, our fallback is to serve stale cached responses. Confirmed?

maria (seceng): Yes, config in `feature-flags.yml`: `allow-stale-on-kms-failure: true` for low-risk routes only. We will monitor exposure.

alex (sec): If audit logs show unauthorized RBAC activity, we stop and rollback immediately. Post-sim tasks: gather logs, run vuln scan against temporary role, open a postmortem.

jessica (oncall): Ready. Starting at 09:30 PT. I'll post start/stop updates. :white_check_mark:

rui (infra): Sim started. Applied netpol, blocked egress to KMS v1, throttling enabled.

audit-bot: [automated] alert: KMS API errors increase 502->503 from svc-a svc-b. sample log: `KMS: ErrConnection: dial tcp ...`

sam (eng-sre): svc-a switched to cached responses after 15s, svc-b retried 3x then used emergency role. Need to confirm token rotation.

maria (seceng): Verified temporary role used at 09:31:12, TTL 15m. Audit entry id: a-1765129876-001. No privilege escalation observed.

katie (platform): Post-sim: reverted netpol, removed temp role, and ran `kms-reconcile`. console shows no key alias drift.

alex (sec): Great. Next: add a short runbook blurb for this scenario and list of mitigations. I'll draft and share. Can all owners add notes to the doc by EOD?

jessica (oncall): Will add incident timeline and traces.

rui (infra): I'll attach the netpol diff and pod-level metrics.

sam (eng-sre): Adding SLO impact calc.

maria (seceng): I'll run a quick vuln triage on the temp role artifacts tomorrow.

alex (sec): Thanks team. Closing thread unless blockers. :lock:
